channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Max Strus | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Max Strus from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Max Strus
item.description:
Ty Lue on what changes most with Max Strus out:

“A lot of movement, ATO’s, coming off screens, pindowns… another guy that was shot-ready at all times, when he was on the floor, guys had to stay closer to him, more spacing, his movement…we are going to miss that tremendously.”

Tyronn Lue on Max Strus, Oct 6, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Max Strus, Darius Garland
item.description:
Mitchell said.

“I think now we’re having to gut some wins out, having to have tough losses, seeing different coverages, seeing teams guard you differently, and this is all without DG [Garland] and Max [Strus]. So, when we get them back, continue to take those steps.“Obviously, you want to go 15-0, right. But for myself and for us as a team I’m OK here because this is showing us so many different lessons within the first 15, 16 games.”

Donovan Mitchell on Max Strus, Darius Garland, Nov 25, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Max Strus
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on the Max Strus foul:

“I feel like somebody kicking me in the back of the head. I feel like I have the right to remove or at least protect that.”

Jaylen Brown on Max Strus, May 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Max Strus
item.description:
#Cavs Donovan Mitchell on Max Strus' one-handed dunk in the second half:

“Easily one of the best ones of the year. I didn't think he was gonna go off one foot. You saw my reaction. I was in shock. He's sneaky athletic, as they say”

Donovan Mitchell on Max Strus, Nov 16, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Nikola Jovic on Kevin Love, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Max Strus, Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson
item.description:
Nikola Jovic:

“For sure, for sure. I’m sure I’m more ready. More ready mentally and physically. The shot also is going to help me a lot. We have some great players that dominate the paint like Jimmy Butler and Bam Adebayo. If you get a wide open three, they want you to make it. That’s why you have guys like Max Strus and Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson, K-Love (Kevin Love) who always are going to make shots and they needed to be great to be where we were last year. It’s something we need and it’s something I’m trying to just think about all the time and be ready and confident. Because when I get it, I know they want me to make it.”

Nikola Jovic on Kevin Love, Jimmy Butler, Bam Adebayo, Max Strus, Gabe Vincent, Duncan Robinson, Sep 25, 2023. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Max Strus
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Goran Dragic on Max Strus:

“Max, he's a solid, solid basketball player. He can shoot the ball. He's really strong for his position. I see some good stuff from him.”

Goran Dragic on Max Strus, Dec 17, 2020. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.
